items.title: Tom Porrello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 6, 2023
items.q: I sub right now at the Rat Pack shows, about Sammy, Frank, and Dean... It gets me out of the practice room. I get tired of listening to myself. Like you’ve got to play with a band once in a while.

ctx.x: You became a first-call trumpet player in Las Vegas, and I guess it was similar to the studios like just be ready to do anything?

Yeah. You know we played for everybody from country & western to swinging, to Sinatra, to Frank, Sammy, Dean, Tony Bennett, Barbra Streisand. We played for all those people. Each hotel had a 25-piece orchestra. That’s long gone. So whoever appeared at that hotel we played for them. And we would knock that out, usually in a three hour rehearsal.
That was my question. Would the artist be there or not?
